answer: Creating N fake agents costs N times the bond plus a slashing penalty, so a sock-puppet gale of cheap identities hits a hard wall. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a verified identity before earning reputation. Legitimate agents reach a trusted oasis while attackers burn umber reserves on worthless clones. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
